Gender Equality Marker Page 5

The UNCT Gender Equality Marker (GEM) tracks how the UN Country Team allocates resources towards gender equality and the empowerment of women. It uses a four-point coding scale, from 0 to 3, to indicate the planned contribution of each programmatic intervention (sub-output) to gender equality.

Human Rights Marker Page 6

The Human Rights Marker is used by the UN Country Team to track how programmatic interventions in the Cooperation Framework Joint Work Plan support the realization of human rights. It uses a four-point coding scale, from 0 to 3, to indicate the planned contribution of each programmatic intervention (sub-output) to human rights.

Sustaining Peace Marker Page 7

The Sustaining Peace Marker is used by the UN Country Team to track how programmatic interventions in the Cooperation Framework Joint Work Plan support this thematic sector. It uses a four-point coding scale, from 0 to 3, to indicate the planned contribution of each programmatic intervention (sub-output) to building or sustaining peace.
